question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` be a public Plugin SDK contract supporting all reply representations, or should tool-progress intent remain a narrower bundled/text-only seam?
rationale: The Slack correctness repair is mechanical, but the branch also creates permanent third-party API and raises public surface budgets; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for that boundary.

options.title: Approve the generic public contract
options.body: Support typed tool-progress consistently across text, native blocks, media, and fallback paths, with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the bundled Codex-to-Slack behavior but make tool-progress text-only or non-public so unsupported representation combinations are not promised.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Hold the PR until the channel and Plugin SDK owners agree on the permanent progress-intent boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic public contract
recommendation.body: Support typed tool-progress consistently across text, native blocks, media, and fallback paths, with focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent merged work owns the current Slack native-data delivery architecture and adjacent public reply-payload SDK surface.
